name: The Fate of the Den
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, thought the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, adventurer. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.
narrative.objectives: Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valannar and tell him what has transpired.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Lotheluum wears a look of genuine terror as you recount the events from the champion den.>I--I'm sorry, Solarus. I need just a moment. There are no words I possess that can describe the loss.This is grave news indeed. If this missive is not fabricated, then we indeed have at best an accomplice and at worst a traitor here in Valanaar. I will take this to the High Elder immediately! I will not let my fellows sacrifice be in vain.
